Definition: from G746 and G71; a chief leader:--author, captain, prince.
BiblicalUsage: The word means a chief leader, the author or captain, the one who goes first. Peter says the Jews killed the Prince of life, God exalted Christ to be a Prince and a Saviour, He is the captain of our salvation made perfect through sufferings, and He is the author and finisher of our faith.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Captain does not send us where He has not gone first. He went through suffering to bring us to glory, and He authors the faith He also finishes.
